subject.title: Regenerar feeds de Merchant Center (multi-país): metadata completa + correcciones de mapeo

question: Should this proceed as a sponsored MX-first Merchant feed generator using the Excel feed manifest, and how should Brazil or other account-enabled country scope be represented in versioned config?
rationale: The code gaps are clear, but live Merchant uploads, country limits, the attached Excel ordering, and the missing Brazil config require operational/product ownership before an autonomous fix PR can safely decide the rollout shape.

options.title: Sponsor MX-first generator
options.body: Implement the mapper and manifest-driven generator, produce local CSV proof, and coordinate the first live upload in MX with Jesús before other countries.

options.title: Split mapper from rollout
options.body: First land the brand/product_type/metadata mapper changes without live upload scope, then track country rollout as a separate operational issue.

options.title: Pause for final account manifest
options.body: Wait until maintainers confirm the enabled-country list, Brazil handling, and Excel contract before changing scripts.

recommendation.title: Sponsor MX-first generator
recommendation.body: Implement the mapper and manifest-driven generator, produce local CSV proof, and coordinate the first live upload in MX with Jesús before other countries.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the current assignee and authored the related Merchant feed PR, making him the best available routing owner for this product/ops decision.
